therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: allogeneic bone marrow transplantation with anti-thymocyte globulin, cyclophosphamide, cyclosporine, methotrexate, methylprednisolone
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: allogeneic hematopoietic stem cell replacement with immunosuppressive conditioning
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: replacement of malignant hematopoietic cells and prevention of graft versus host disease
